title: Typography
slide_intent: Teach designers to establish reading order through a few deliberate differences in weight, spacing or size.
strategic_value: Restricting the number of styles can preserve Sheffield Museums’ clear voice across many kinds of information.
demonstration: A narrow column explains hierarchy, size limits and alignment. An oversized lowercase specimen dominates the rest of the page and extends to the edge.
practical_value: Try weight or spacing before introducing another size. Aim for no more than three point sizes per application and choose centered or left-aligned text.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the rules in a narrow column below the page heading. End the column with the alignment and style-count guidance.

content_islands.name: Oversized specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the black lowercase abcdef sequence across the broad right-hand area. Crop it against the page edge.
